  CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer m γ U S i e =
    if m.tail e = i then CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.tail e)) (U (m.head e)) (S e))

      if m.head e = i then CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.head e)) (U (m.tail e)) (-S e))

  CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer m γ U S i e =

    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S) + CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T)
CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.name: CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof_1

CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (a : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (a • S)) =
    (RingHom.id ℝ) a • CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S)
CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.name: CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof_2

CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer.eq_1

CFDLean.Assembly.residual.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      [inst : DecidableEq N] →
        [inst : Fintype E] →
          [inst : Fintype B] →
            {d : ℕ} →
              CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B → (E → CFDLean.Vector d) → (B → CFDLean.Vector d) → N → CFDLean.Vector d
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual

CFDLean.Assembly.residual._cstage1.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      [inst : DecidableEq N] →
        [inst : Fintype E] →
          [inst : Fintype B] →
            {d : ℕ} →
              CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B → (E → CFDLean.Vector d) → (B → CFDLean.Vector d) → N → CFDLean.Vector d
CFDLean.Assembly.residual._cstage1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual._cstage1

CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i =
    ∑ e, CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e • f e + ∑ b, if m.owner b = i then g b else 0
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d k : ℕ} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (L : CFDLean.Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] CFDLean.Vector k)
  (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (fun e => L (f e)) (fun b => L (g b)) i = L (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i =
    ∑ e ∈ {e | m.tail e = i}, f e - ∑ e ∈ {e | m.head e = i}, f e + ∑ b ∈ {b | m.owner b = i}, g b
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst_3 : DecidableEq N'] [inst_4 : Fintype E'] [inst_5 : Fintype B']
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : N ≃ N') (e : E ≃ E') (b : B ≃ B') (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d)
  (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reindex n e b) (fun j => f (e.symm j)) (fun j => g (b.symm j)) (n i) =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (rev : E → Prop) [inst_3 : DecidablePred rev] (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d)
  (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reverse rev) (fun e => if rev e then -f e else f e) g i =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B →

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.tail e)) (U (m.head e)) (S e))
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S e = (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (S e)
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (e : E),
  S e = 0 → CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e = 0
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero

CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S) g i = ∑ b, g b
CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance

CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reindex.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst_3 : DecidableEq N'] [inst_4 : Fintype E'] [inst_5 : Fintype B']
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : N ≃ N') (e : E ≃ E') (b : B ≃ B') (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reindex n e b)
      (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer (m.reindex n e b) γ (fun j => U (n.symm j)) fun j => S (e.symm j))
      (fun j => g (b.symm j)) (n i) =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S) g i
CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reindex.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reindex

CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reverse.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (rev : E → Prop) [inst_3 : DecidablePred rev] (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reverse rev)
      (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer (m.reverse rev) γ U fun e => if rev e then -S e else S e) g i =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S) g i
CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reverse.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reverse

      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving 0 1) i =

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.single.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
      (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (b₀ : M.Boundary),
      (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
          CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M b₀ →
            CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V (fun x => U) b =
              (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b)) →
        CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) (M.interfaces.owner b₀) =
          CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V (fun x => U) b₀ -
            (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b₀)

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.transp.type:
CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual
    (CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard.interfaces.reindex (Equiv.swap 0 1)
      (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.edge01 CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.edge02)
      (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.wallPatch CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.openPatch))
    2
    (fun b =>
      CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.mixedKinds
        ((Equiv.symm
            (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.wallPatch CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.openPatch))
          b))
    (fun b =>
      CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard
        CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.mismatchingData
        ((Equiv.symm
            (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.wallPatch CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.openPatch))
          b))
    (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving 0 1)
    (fun e =>
      CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard.edgeArea
        ((Equiv.symm (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.edge01 CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.edge02)) e))
    (fun b =>
      CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.standard.boundaryArea
        ((Equiv.symm
            (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.wallPatch CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.openPatch))
          b))
    1 =
  ![-1 / 12, -1 / 6, 0, 0, -1 / 3]

              CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoSymmetry then
        CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.inviscidSymmetryTraction

      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving q 1) (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.moving q 1)

CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.two_ce.type:
CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells.interfaces.owner CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoWall =
    CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells.interfaces.owner CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoSymmetry ∧
  CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells.interfaces.owner CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoWall =
      CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoCells.interfaces.owner CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoOpen ∧

CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer.eq_.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (b : B),
  CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V U T b = CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ (k b) (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b)

CFDLean.Boundary.constructed_transfer_re.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : N ≃ N') (e : E ≃ E') (b : B ≃ B') (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (j : B'),
  CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer (m.reindex n e b) γ (fun x => k (b.symm x)) (fun x => V (b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (n.symm x)) (fun x => T (b.symm x)) j =
    CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V U T (b.symm j)

{n m : ℕ} →
  CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m →
    ℝ →
      (Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) →
        (Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) →
          (Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → Fin n → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates
CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual.name: CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual

CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual_eq.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual M.interfaces (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ U M.edgeArea)
      (CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U) i
CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual_eq.name: CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual_eq

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
      (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
      CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) i =
        ∑ b,
          if M.interfaces.owner b = i then
            CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V (fun x => U) b -
              (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b)
          else 0
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ),
      1 < γ →
        ∀ (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3),
          CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
            ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
              (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                  CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                    CFDLean.dot U.momentum (M.boundaryArea b) = 0) →
                (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                    CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                      CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b = U) →
                  CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) i = 0
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i = ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq N'] [inst_1 : Fintype E']
  [inst_2 : Fintype B'] (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (nodeEq : Fin n ≃ N') (e : M.Edge ≃ E')
  (b : M.Boundary ≃ B') (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (M.interfaces.reindex nodeEq e b) γ
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k (b.symm x)) (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V (b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (nodeEq.symm x)) (fun x => M.edgeArea (e.symm x)) (fun x => M.boundaryArea (b.symm x)) (nodeEq i) =
    CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex

    ℝ →
      (Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) →
        (Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) →
          (Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → M.Boundary → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates
CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer

CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer.eq_1.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (b : M.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b =
    CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) (U (M.interfaces.owner b))
      (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) (M.boundaryArea b)

CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_prescribe.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (b : M.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
    CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b =
      CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b)) (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b)
        (M.boundaryArea b)

CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_symmetry.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (b : M.Boundary),
  CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.inviscidSymmetryTraction →
    CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b =
      CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b)) (M.boundaryArea b)

  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (b : M.Boundary),

  CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ V U (-T) = -CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T
CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_reverse.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_reverse

CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_scale.type:
∀ (γ a : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  0 ≤ a →
    CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V (a • T) =
      a • CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T
CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_scale.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_scale

CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_exter.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ V →
        T ≠ 0 →
          CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V))
                (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal T) ≤
              -CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V) →
            CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T =
              CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ V T)
CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_exter.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_exterior

CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_owner.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ V →
        T ≠ 0 →
          CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V) ≤
              CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V))
                (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal T) →
            CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T =
              CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T)
CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_owner.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_owner

CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_zero.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_zero

CFDLean.Boundary.pressureTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Boundary.pressureTransfer.eq_1

CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace.eq_1.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (b : M.Boundary), CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace M b = M.faceID (↑b).1
CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Boundary.primalFace.eq_1

CFDLean.Boundary.residual_boundary_diffe.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates)
  (g h : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i = CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f h i + ∑ b, if m.owner b = i then g b - h b else 0

CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      [inst : DecidableEq N] →
        [inst : Fintype E] →
          [inst : Fintype B] →
            CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B →
              ℝ →
                (B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) →
                  (B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) →
                    (N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) →
                      (E → CFDLean.Vector 3) → (B → CFDLean.Vector 3) → N → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates
CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_close.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  (∀ (b : B), k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → CFDLean.dot U.momentum (T b) = 0) →
    (∀ (b : B), k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → V b = U) →
      CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i = 0 → CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i = 0
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_close.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_closed

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_corre.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i)) +
      ∑ b,
        if m.owner b = i then
          CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V (fun x => U) T b - (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)
        else 0
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_corre.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_correction

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_defec.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  (∀ (b : B), k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → CFDLean.dot U.momentum (T b) = 0) →
    (∀ (b : B), k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → V b = U) →
      CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i =
        CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i))
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_defec.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_defect

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_component_ba.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (j : Fin 5),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i j = ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V U T b j
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_component_ba.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_component_balance

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_energy_balan.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i 4 =
    ∑ b,
      if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
        CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b) 4
      else 0
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_energy_balan.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_energy_balance

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_global_balan.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i = ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V U T b
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_global_balan.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_global_balance

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mass_balance.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i 0 =
    ∑ b,
      if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
        CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b) 0
      else 0
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mass_balance.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mass_balance

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mixed_balanc.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i =
    (∑ b,
        if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
          CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b)
        else 0) +
      ∑ b,
        if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then 0
        else CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (T b)
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mixed_balanc.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mixed_balance

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_bal.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (j : Fin 3),
  ∑ i, (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i)).momentum j =
    ∑ b,
      if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
              (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b))).momentum
          j
      else CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (U (m.owner b)) * T b j
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_bal.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_balance

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_residual_rei.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst_3 : DecidableEq N'] [inst_4 : Fintype E'] [inst_5 : Fintype B']
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : N ≃ N') (e : E ≃ E') (b : B ≃ B') (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (m.reindex n e b) γ (fun x => k (b.symm x)) (fun x => V (b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (n.symm x)) (fun x => S (e.symm x)) (fun x => T (b.symm x)) (n i) =
    CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_residual_rei.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_residual_reindex

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_compatible.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  (k ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → CFDLean.dot U.momentum T = 0) →
    (k = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → V = U) →
      CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ k U V T = (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) T
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_compatible.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_compatible

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_energy.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ k U V T 4 =
    if k = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T 4
    else 0
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_energy.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_energy

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_mass.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ k U V T 0 =
    if k = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T 0
    else 0
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_mass.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_mass

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_momentum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3) (j : Fin 3),
  (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ k U V T)).momentum j =
    if k = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T)).momentum j
    else CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U * T j
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_momentum.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_momentum

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_split.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ k U V T =
    (if k = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ U V T
      else 0) +
      if k = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then 0 else CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_split.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_split

CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T = CFDLean.Boundary.pressureTransfer (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U) T
CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer.eq_1

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_add.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (S + T) = CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U S + CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_add.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_add

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_energy.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T 4 = 0
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_energy.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_energy

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T = CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T) ↔
    CFDLean.dot U.momentum T = 0
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  0 < U.density →
    T ≠ 0 →
      (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T = CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T) ↔
        CFDLean.dot (fun i => U.momentum i / U.density) (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal T) = 0)
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_normalVelocity

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_mass.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T 0 = 0
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_mass.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_mass

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : Fin 3),
  (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T)).momentum i =
    CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U * T i
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_pressure_pos.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3), CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U → 0 < CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_pressure_pos.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_pressure_pos

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (-T) = -CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_reverse.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_reverse

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_smul.type:
∀ (γ a : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (a • T) = a • CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_smul.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_smul

CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),

CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible.eq_1

      { density := density_1, momentum := momentum_1, energy := energy_1 } →

CFDLean.Conservative.mk.inj.name: CFDLean.Conservative.mk.inj

CFDLean.Conservative.mk.injEq.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (density : ℝ) (momentum : CFDLean.Vector d) (energy density_1 : ℝ) (momentum_1 : CFDLean.Vector d)
  (energy_1 : ℝ),
  ({ density := density, momentum := momentum, energy := energy } =
      { density := density_1, momentum := momentum_1, energy := energy_1 }) =
    (density = density_1 ∧ momentum = momentum_1 ∧ energy = energy_1)
CFDLean.Conservative.mk.injEq.name: CFDLean.Conservative.mk.injEq

CFDLean.Conservative.mk.sizeOf_spec.type:

  sizeOf { density := density, momentum := momentum, energy := energy } = 1 + sizeOf density + sizeOf energy
CFDLean.Conservative.mk.sizeOf_spec.name: CFDLean.Conservative.mk.sizeOf_spec

  CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U = (γ - 1) * (U.energy - CFDLean.squareSum U.momentum / (2 * U.density))

  CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot = 5 ∧
    CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot = √5

  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →

        CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.jump 0 =
      3 * √5 / 5

CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.mass_f.type:

  S ≠ 0 →

      -3 * √5 * CFDLean.Coordinates.area S / 10

CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.nonpar.type:

    CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot

CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_determina.type:

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_opposite_d.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),

        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +

          CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n]

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum..type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n =
    n 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + n 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
      n 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum..name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum.eq_1

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDiffere.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x =
    (γ - 1) •
      (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
          (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
              CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
        (CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDiffere.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential.eq_1

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formul.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure γ x = (γ - 1) * (x 4 - (x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 + x 3 ^ 2) / (2 * x 0))
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formul.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formula

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1.type:
∀ (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i = (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).momentum i / x 0
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1

{d : ℕ} →
  {motive : CFDLean.Primitive d → Sort u} →

CFDLean.Primitive.casesOn.name: CFDLean.Primitive.casesOn

CFDLean.Primitive.mk.type: {d : ℕ} → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector d → ℝ → CFDLean.Primitive d
CFDLean.Primitive.mk.name: CFDLean.Primitive.mk

CFDLean.Primitive.mk._flat_ctor.type: {d : ℕ} → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector d → ℝ → CFDLean.Primitive d
CFDLean.Primitive.mk._flat_ctor.name: CFDLean.Primitive.mk._flat_ctor

CFDLean.Primitive.mk.inj.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} {density : ℝ} {velocity : CFDLean.Vector d} {pressure density_1 : ℝ} {velocity_1 : CFDLean.Vector d}
  {pressure_1 : ℝ},
  { density := density, velocity := velocity, pressure := pressure } =

CFDLean.Primitive.mk.injEq.type:

  (pressure_1 : ℝ),

CFDLean.Primitive.mk.injEq.name: CFDLean.Primitive.mk.injEq

CFDLean.Primitive.mk.sizeOf_spec.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (density : ℝ) (velocity : CFDLean.Vector d) (pressure : ℝ),
  sizeOf { density := density, velocity := velocity, pressure := pressure } = 1 + sizeOf density + sizeOf pressure
CFDLean.Primitive.mk.sizeOf_spec.name: CFDLean.Primitive.mk.sizeOf_spec

CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusion.type: {d : ℕ} → {P : Sort u} → {v1 v2 : CFDLean.Primitive d} → v1 = v2 → CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusionType P v1 v2
CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusion.name: CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusion

CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusionType.type: {d : ℕ} → Sort u → CFDLean.Primitive d → CFDLean.Primitive d → Sort u
CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusionType.name: CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusionType

CFDLean.Primitive.rec.type:
{d : ℕ} →
  {motive : CFDLean.Primitive d → Sort u} →
    ((density : ℝ) →
        (velocity : CFDLean.Vector d) →

CFDLean.Primitive.rec.name: CFDLean.Primitive.rec

{d : ℕ} →
